description: Use when a traveller on a Vietnam e-visa needs to know whether a specific airport, land border crossing (from Cambodia, Laos or China) or sea port accepts e-visas, or wants the list of gates for one border. Returns listed / not_listed, the legal basis (Resolution 127/NQ-CP and 389/NQ-CP), and a flag for airports that apply only once they open. Call with no arguments for the full list of 83.

border_country.description: For land gates: Cambodia, Laos or China

query.description: Gate or province name, accents optional, e.g. "Moc Bai", "Lao Bao", "Phu Quoc"

name: evisa_entry_ports

error.description: Present only when the input was invalid

title: Vietnam e-visa entry and exit gates
